topics.label: Lecture opening and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the introductory framing and outlines the learning objectives for the lecture.

topics.label: Tumor viruses, proto-oncogenes, and cellular transformation assays
topics.groupedBecause: They trace how the investigation of transforming tumor viruses revealed cellular proto-oncogenes and established experimental assays to evaluate transforming mutations.

topics.label: Cancer gene classifications, cell cycle control, and mutant mechanisms
topics.groupedBecause: They examine the functional classifications of cancer mutations and illustrate their behaviour through cell cycle regulatory pathways and gene dosage effects.

topics.label: Mechanisms and pathways of genetic instability
topics.groupedBecause: They detail the cellular defects in DNA repair, DNA replication, and mitotic chromosome segregation that generate sequence and chromosomal instability in cancer.

topics.label: Multi-step tumor progression and hereditary cancer predispositions
topics.groupedBecause: They explore how the stepwise accumulation or inheritance of cancer-driving mutations governs tumor progression, clinical cancer syndromes, and tumor evolution.

topics.label: Closing remarks and recommended reading
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the concluding administrative remarks and recommended reading for the lecture.
